papers.title_en: MPBRS: Multi-Potential-Based Reward Shaping for Unified Reward Configuration in Humanoid Locomotion
papers.authors: Van Chung Nguyen, Hung Manh La
papers.evidence: 面向人形机器人运动的多元势函数奖励塑形
papers.tldr: 人形机器人强化学习行走的奖励函数设计与调参仍很困难，朴素奖励塑形容易与目标行为冲突、过拟合特定机器人，并对权重变化敏感。本文研究多势能奖励塑形 MPBRS，提出统一奖励配置，仅依赖关节/连杆映射和默认姿态等机器人元数据。在九种人形机器人上的实验表明，MPBRS 比标准塑形具有更一致的缩放行为和更低的调参敏感性。该工作为跨机器人复用奖励结构、降低人工设计成本提供了可行方案。
papers.abstract_en: Designing and tuning reward functions remains one of the main challenges in building effective reinforcement learning (RL) pipelines for humanoid locomotion. While shaping rewards can accelerate learning, naively formulated terms often conflict with the desired behavior, overfit to a specific robot, or become unstable under small weight changes. Potential-Based Reward Shaping (PBRS) offers an alternative solution: shaping the reward via differences of a potential function to guide exploration without changing the optimal policy. In this paper, we study Multi-PBRS for humanoid locomotion and propose a unified reward configuration. We then evaluate the same reward structure and weights across nine humanoid robots, requiring only robot-specific metadata (joint/link mappings and default poses) rather than per-robot reward redesign. Our experiments show that, compared to standard shaping, MPBRS provides more consistent scaling behavior and reduced tuning sensitivity across robots, making it easier to tune without altering the optimal policy.

papers.title_en: Soft-Update MSA for Nonconvex Stochastic Optimal Control: Theory and Algorithms
papers.authors: Shaolin Ji, Xinmeng Liu
papers.evidence: 随机最优控制理论与逐次逼近算法
papers.tldr: 非凸随机最优控制中，MSA受限于SMP仅提供最优性条件而非下降规则。作者提出软更新MSA（SU-MSA），对Hamiltonian作二阶伴随修正，并给出保证代价下降的显式步长与收敛性证明。为扩展到高维，进一步用可微光滑近似构造DeepSMP，并分析目标及其梯度收敛。数值实验在多个任务上验证了所提框架的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: For the method of successive approximations (MSA), a fundamental challenge is that the stochastic maximum principle (SMP) provides an optimality condition rather than a descent rule. To overcome this difficulty for nonconvex stochastic control problems, we develop a soft-update MSA (SU-MSA) with a second-order-adjoint correction of the Hamiltonian and a neural realization called DeepSMP. Both an explicit stepsize rule guaranteeing cost descent and the convergence of the algorithm are established. Moreover, the global SMP condition is asymptotically satisfied when the corrected Hamiltonian is convex, while in a special case the cost is further proved to converge to the global optimum. To extend SU-MSA to high dimensions, we develop DeepSMP using a differentiable smooth approximation of the corrected Hamiltonian and analyze the convergence of the resulting objective and its gradient. Numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

papers.title_en: QuaNAS: Uncertainty-Aware Reuse of Earlier Searches for Query-Efficient Neural Architecture Search
papers.authors: Brama Seta Putra Satria, Dwi Sunaryono, Misbakhul Munir Irfan Subakti, Irzal Ahmad Sabilla, Laras Suciningtyas
papers.evidence: 复用历史搜索的高查询效率神经架构搜索
papers.tldr: 新数据集上的NAS常只允许数十次短训练，现有方法多从零开始，零成本代理跨任务不可靠。QuaNAS把同搜索空间的历史搜索当作可靠性不确定的显式知识，用设计决策主效应和零成本代理构建先验，并由高斯过程在每次评估后重估先验可信度。在12个图像、时序、文本和表格数据集上，其短训练目标的anytime regret较五个从零开始基线降低2.7至3.9倍，最终模型在9个数据集上不劣于或超过匹配配方参考模型。这表明谨慎复用早期搜索可显著提升查询效率，并使迁移知识可检查。
papers.abstract_en: Neural architecture search (NAS) on a new dataset often affords only tens of short training runs, so what the search knows before its first evaluation decides its efficiency. Yet most NAS methods start from scratch, guided at best by zero-cost proxies that are unreliable across tasks. QuaNAS treats a library of earlier searches in the same search space as explicit knowledge of uncertain reliability. Main effects of design decisions learned from this library and, secondarily, zero-cost proxies become priors over candidate architectures without any label of the new dataset. A Gaussian process starts at the prior optimum and re-estimates after every evaluation how far each prior is trusted. Under a protocol frozen before any confirmation data were seen, QuaNAS was evaluated once on 12 new image, time-series, text and tabular datasets. It lowered anytime regret on the short-training objective 2.7- to 3.9-fold relative to five pre-specified NAS baselines that start from scratch (Holm-adjusted p = 0.0012 each). Its final models matched (non-inferiority margin 0.5 pp) or exceeded matched-recipe reference models on nine datasets, as did the prior optimum, selected without a single evaluation. Post-hoc comparisons with established transfer methods given the same library trace the gain to the library: without it, the same Gaussian process had over twice the regret. They also show where each transfer mechanism works best: the pooled main effects of QuaNAS for weakly transferable tabular tasks, per-task surrogates for image, time-series and text tasks and for small or mismatched libraries. Finally, the main effects make the transferred knowledge inspectable.

papers.title_en: Humanoid Mobility via Attention-based Contacts
papers.authors: Junzhe He, Kehan Wen, Chong Zhang, Clemens Schwarke, Zewei Zhang, Kaixian Qu, Siyuan Hu, Matthias Müller, Vladlen Koltun, Marco Hutter
papers.evidence: 面向复杂地形人形机器人全身运动的强化学习框架
papers.tldr: 复杂地形人形移动需要准确落脚与全身协调：无参考RL泛化好但协调难，参考动作自然却难超出训练轨迹。本文把动作数据仅作训练先验，用自监督注意力接触规划器预测未来身体—环境接触，再由接触条件跟踪器生成全身动作，使接触成为感知与控制的接口。部署时仅用机载观测、无需参考输入，单一策略可兼顾自然协调与RL探索，并在挑战环境中实现灵活移动。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid mobility over complex terrain requires accurate foot placement and coordinated whole-body motion capable of robust adaptation. Reinforcement learning (RL) policies trained without motion references generalize well across terrains, yet eliciting effective whole-body coordination through reward design and exploration alone remains challenging. In contrast, reference-based methods yield natural motions but struggle to adapt beyond the predefined trajectories in their training data. We introduce a learning framework that bridges these two approaches by using motion data strictly as a training prior. An explicit, self-supervised, attention-based contact planner predicts future body-environment contacts, while a contact-conditioned tracker translates these plans into coordinated whole-body motion. Together, they establish contact as an interface between sensory observations and control actions. This abstraction allows the policy to internalize the contact-aware structure of locomotion rather than directly replicating kinematics. Consequently, a single policy can exploit data-driven motion priors for natural whole-body coordination while retaining the flexibility to discover environment-dependent behaviors through reinforcement learning. Building on the learned contact planner and tracker, a subsequent fine-tuning stage bootstraps their acquired capabilities to explore environment variations beyond those covered by the original motion data. Operating entirely from onboard observations without any reference inputs at deployment, this framework enables versatile humanoid mobility in challenging environments.

papers.title_en: DiPLO: Self-distilled Diffusion Planning for Loco-manipulation
papers.authors: Shafeef Omar, Sebastian Sanokowski, Elham Daneshmand, Dian Yu, Daniel Cremers, Cordelia Schmid, Majid Khadiv
papers.evidence: 面向人形机器人移动操作的强化学习全身跟踪策略
papers.tldr: DPO 去除强任务条件依赖，并用 DA:PPO 对齐冻结跟踪器。取-搬-放任务成功率由预训练模型 45% 提升至 99%，并可泛化到未见物体目标及踢、推拉任务。最终在 Unitree G1 实机零微调重复成功部署。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid loco-manipulation is particularly challenging because it requires coordinating locomotion, balance, and object interaction, making it difficult to learn from limited demonstrations or from scratch through Reinforcement Learning (RL). We introduce DiPLO (self-distilled Diffusion Planning for Loco-manipulation), a framework that combines a self-distilled diffusion planner with a low-level whole-body tracking policy. Our planner is pretrained via supervised learning on motions derived from human-to-humanoid retargeting, while the tracker is trained via RL to execute them. DiPLO centers around two complementary post-training stages. First, we introduce Self-Distillation Diffusion Policy Optimisation (SD:DPO) to remove the planner's dependence on strong task conditioning, which we identify as a crucial ingredient for effective pretraining, as downstream fine-tuning does not recover comparable performance when it is omitted.. We then fine-tune this distilled model with Diffusion-Augmented Proximal Policy Optimization (DA:PPO), a maximum-entropy RL method for diffusion models, to improve task success and align generated plans with the frozen tracker's execution capabilities. Together, these stages enable motion generation through state-history and goal conditioning alone, enabling 99% task success in pick-carry-place tasks, compared to just 45% for the pretrained model. The resulting planner also generates motions for unseen object goals, with further evaluations on kicking and pushing/pulling tasks. Finally, we deploy our pipeline on the hardware, using our DA:PPO planner-tracker on a Unitree G1, achieving repeated successful executions without any real-world fine-tuning.

papers.title_en: Constrained Koopman Control Parametrization: Convex Controller Synthesis for Tracking under Input Constraints
papers.authors: Taha Ondogan, Ran Jing, Andrew P. Sabelhaus, Roberto Tron
papers.evidence: 基于Koopman算子的输入约束凸控制器综合
papers.tldr: Koopman理论可将非线性系统表示为可观测量的线性/双线性模型，但输入约束下的控制器综合仍受限。本文提出cKoCoP框架，通过线性于可观测量的反馈实现非线性状态反馈，并用凸优化纳入椭球/多面体输入约束与跟踪CLF，获得Lyapunov认证的升维闭环稳定性。在双摆和独轮车上验证了数据驱动跟踪满足约束，且在线计算成本显著低于KMPC。该工作为实时约束跟踪提供了可行路径。
papers.abstract_en: Koopman operator theory represents nonlinear systems with linear and bilinear terms in the state and input observables, greatly simplifying control design. However, incorporating input constraints into Koopman-based controller synthesis remains challenging, limiting their applicability to constrained control tasks such as tracking. This paper develops a constrained Koopman Control Parametrization (cKoCoP) framework for synthesizing state-feedback controllers that satisfy prescribed input constraints with Lyapunov-certified stability of the identified lifted closed loop. The cKoCoP offers nonlinear state-feedback via linear-in-observables feedback, enabling linear controller design. The proposed controller is obtained through convex optimization: we incorporate ellipsoidal or polytopic input constraints with the S-procedure or Farkas-lemma-based conditions. We also introduce a Control Lyapunov Function (CLF) for trajectory tracking which incorporates input constraints. The approach is validated on two canonical nonlinear systems, a double pendulum and a unicycle, demonstrating data-driven tracking while respecting input constraints. Experiments validate the method's robustness to measurement noise, and runtime improvements over Koopman Model Predictive Control (KMPC) baselines. The results demonstrate that cKoCoP achieves competitive tracking performance with substantially reduced online computational cost, supporting its potential for real-time constrained tracking applications.

papers.title_en: Primal-Dual Representation Learning for Low-Rank Constrained MDPs
papers.authors: Chenhao Zhou, Chao Zhang, Wensong Bai, Hanbin Zhao, Hui Qian
papers.evidence: 控制约束违反的受限MDP表示学习
papers.tldr: 针对连续状态约束MDP中表示学习需同时控制约束违反的难题，论文研究低秩CMDP并提出REP-PD-TEG：先用衰减ε-greedy混合策略采样并以最大似然学习转移特征，再结合不确定性奖励与乐观拉格朗日规划求解回报策略。理论上给出遗憾与软累计违反保证，回报界达O~(√K)，计入探索动作后总样本界为O~(K^{3/4})。进一步提出REP-PD-H-TEG，用奖励修正下置信效用证书和稳定对偶搜索实现逐回合可行性验证，获得硬违反界。该工作首次为低秩连续状态CMDP提供兼具软保证与可认证硬违反控制的表示学习理论方法。
papers.abstract_en: Representation learning has substantially improved the efficiency of unconstrained continuous-state Markov Decision Processes (MDPs), but its extension to Constrained MDPs (CMDPs) is difficult because the transition representation must be learned while constraint violation is controlled. In this paper, we study representation learning for low-rank CMDPs with continuous state spaces, and propose REP-PD-TEG for the soft cumulative-violation setting. In the feature learning period, the algorithm interacts with the environment using a decaying-$ε$-greedy mixture execution policy, and uses the collected samples to learn transition features by maximum likelihood. Based on the learned features, it constructs uncertainty bonuses and plans with an optimistic Lagrangian objective to obtain the return policy. We prove regret and soft-violation guarantees for the return policies, and quantify the influence of the decaying-$ε$-greedy exploration. In particular, REP-PD-TEG achieves the optimal $\widetilde O(\sqrt K)$ return policy bound, and gives a $\widetilde O(K^{3/4})$ overall sample bound when exploratory actions are charged. For the stricter hard cumulative violation, where feasibility must be verified episode by episode, we propose REP-PD-H-TEG. It plans under a bonus-corrected lower-confidence utility certificate with the learned representation, and performs a stabilized dual search to obtain the return policy, yielding regret and hard-violation bounds. Together, these results give the first theoretically guaranteed representation-learning method for low-rank continuous-state CMDPs with both soft cumulative guarantees and certified hard-violation control.

papers.title_en: CoEvolve: Self-Evolving Code Policies from Skills to Strategies for Humanoid Robots
papers.authors: Zicheng Liu, Haochen Wu, Jiawei He, Suyun Zhao, Huan Yang, Cheng Chi, Hao Tang
papers.evidence: 人形机器人协调的自演化代码策略
papers.tldr: 单机器人受本体限制，多机器人协作在物理执行偏离时难以调整。CoEvolve将团队协作表示为基于固定运动技能的可执行代码，并用验证器引导协调演化：多模态基础模型生成运动基元、语义目标、临时角色与有界参数，物理验证拒绝后从检查点结构化修订并保留经验。两个Unitree G1在受限走廊搬运刚体，15次基础任务完成8次，三种多模态骨干均端到端成功，并在额外布局与经验初始化下验证放置。该工作表明可执行协调可作为共享物理约束下长时程多机器人协作的实用接口。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and World Action Models (WAMs) have expanded the manipulation and whole body capabilities of individual robots. Yet a single robot remains limited by its embodiment, and many real world tasks require capabilities that can only emerge through cooperation. Existing multi robot frameworks largely emphasize task decomposition, allocation, and replanning, while providing limited support for adapting executable coordination when physical execution deviates from the intended behavior. We present CoEvolve, a framework that represents team coordination as executable code over fixed robot motor skills. CoEvolve introduces Verifier Guided Coordination Evolution, where a multimodal foundation model instantiates coordination strategies through motion primitives, semantic objectives, temporary robot roles, and bounded execution parameters. Physical verification evaluates each executed transition, rejected behaviors trigger structured coordination revision from an accepted checkpoint, and verified experience is retained to guide subsequent decisions. We evaluate CoEvolve with two simulated Unitree G1 humanoids transporting a freely supported rigid payload through constrained corridors. Across 15 base task runs with three multimodal backbone families, CoEvolve completes 8 tasks, with every backbone achieving end to end success. Additional evaluations yield verified placement on two additional corridor layouts and after both same-backbone and cross-backbone experience initialization, while exposing persistent limitations in motion precision and contact stability. These results support executable coordination as a practical interface for adapting long horizon multi robot collaboration under shared physical constraints.

papers.title_en: Fast Motion Retargeting Pipeline for Scalable Humanoid Robot Learning
papers.authors: Daniel Marew, Sangjun Park, Nisal Perera, Donghyun Kim
papers.evidence: 面向人形运动重定向的并行分块处理
papers.tldr: 大规模人体动作数据可用于人形机器人学习，但将多样动作重定向到不同机器人仍困难，现有优化昂贵且常需逐动作调参。FRDV先做带机器人约束的快速运动学重定向，结合自定义SQP、实时迭代与分块并行，并用接触隐式iLQR做动力学校验与修正。其速度最高约9156帧/秒，较GMR和ProtoMotions快约136倍，可减少穿地、自碰撞、脚浮与脚滑等问题。经跟踪强化学习评估并在Unitree G1实现sim-to-real。
papers.abstract_en: While large-scale human motion capture datasets provide a rich source of demonstrations for humanoid robot learning, retargeting the diverse motions to different humanoid robots remains a nontrivial challenge. Existing kinodynamic trajectory optimization pipelines are computationally expensive and often require manual adjustments per motion. We present FRDV (Fast Retargeting with Dynamics Validation), a scalable framework consisting of rapid constrained kinematic retargeting and an additional dynamics validation pipeline. Its kinematic stage integrates a custom Sequential Quadratic Programming solver, Real-Time Iteration, and parallel chunk-based processing, achieving up to 9,156 frames per second, approximately up to 136 times faster than GMR and ProtoMotions, while robot-specific constraints are incorporated into the optimization to reduce common retargeting artifacts, such as ground penetration and self-collision. For motions requiring additional verification, a contact implicit iLQR controller is utilized to test the retargeted reference under full rigid body dynamics. This dynamics-based validation identifies dynamically infeasible motions and refines contact-related artifacts such as foot floating and foot skating. We evaluate retargeting quality by training motion tracking reinforcement learning policies using several state-of-the-art pipelines and comparing their tracking fidelity and success rates. Furthermore, sim-to-real transfer is demonstrated on a Unitree G1 humanoid. Videos and code are available at: https://daroslab.github.io/frdv/.

papers.title_en: VLM-Guided Contact Retargeting and Generative Partner Modeling for Humanoid-Human Interaction
papers.authors: Yuto Shibata, Kotaro Amaya, Kashu Yamazaki, Lalit Jayanti, Yoshimitsu Aoki, Mariko Isogawa, Katerina Fragkiadaki
papers.evidence: 从示范学习人形-人交互控制策略
papers.tldr: 人形机器人与人交互时，近距离接触会遮挡伙伴并导致位姿估计失败，且动捕数据含相互遮挡误差。REACT以语义接触结构为核心监督信号，先用VLM引导接触建模与重定向，再学习特权交互策略并蒸馏为仅依赖机载深度感知的可部署策略，同时引入生成式伙伴状态建模应对严重部分可观测。仿真与Unitree G1真机五项接触丰富任务验证，语义接触建模显著保留演示交互，生成式建模提升四项任务接触召回，真机仅用机载传感完成全部五项交互。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid-human interaction requires robots to operate under severe partial observability: during close physical contact, the human partner is occluded, truncated, or outside the robot's field of view, causing pose estimation to fail and often necessitating external tracking or privileged human state. At the same time, heavy mutual occlusions introduce errors into the human-human motion-capture data used for learning. We present REACT, a framework for learning deployable humanoid-human interaction policies from human-human demonstrations. REACT treats semantic contact structure as the key supervisory signal connecting demonstration processing, interaction learning, and onboard control. First, a VLM-guided contact modeling and retargeting pipeline identifies semantically meaningful contacts and transfers them onto humanoid-human geometry while preserving interaction structure. Using these annotations, privileged interaction policies learn physically grounded behaviors through interaction-aware contact rewards and are then distilled into deployable egocentric depth policies trained entirely from onboard sensing using photorealistic human depth rendering. To address severe partial observability, we introduce generative partner-state modeling objectives that predict partner motion from occluded egocentric views. We evaluate REACT in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 humanoid across five contact-rich interactions. Semantic contact modeling substantially improves preservation of demonstrated interactions, while generative partner-state modeling improves contact recall on four of five interactions, most under heavy occlusion. On real hardware, REACT performs all five interactions using onboard sensing alone.

papers.title_en: Hard and Soft Real-Time DNN Inference Scheduling on Heterogeneous Multi-Accelerator Systems via Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Francesco Giulio Blanco, Enrico Russo, Giuseppe Ascia, Davide Patti, Maurizio Palesi
papers.evidence: 带运行时认证保障硬实时约束的RL调度器
papers.tldr: 异构多加速器需同时承载硬实时与软实时QoS感知DNN推理，调度需兼顾截止期保证与利用率。本文把在线强化学习调度器与确定性运行时安全层结合，联合选择子作业优先级和加速器分配，并用基于机器切分的可调度性保持前缀替换准则做运行时认证。实验表明该框架在保持HRT可调度性的同时，提升QoS截止满足、客户端服务质量和加速器利用率。其贡献在于将学习调度与可认证安全保证解耦融合。
papers.abstract_en: We present a scheduling framework for heterogeneous multi-accelerator systems executing both hard real-time and soft real-time QoS-aware DNN inference workloads. The framework combines an online reinforcement learning (RL) scheduler with a deterministic runtime safety layer. The RL scheduler dynamically generates candidate schedules by jointly selecting sub-job priorities and accelerator assignments, while runtime certification guarantees that all HRT deadlines remain satisfied independently of the learned policy.   To enable runtime certification in heterogeneous precedence-constrained systems, we introduce a schedulability-preserving prefix replacement criterion based on machine-wise cuts. The proposed criterion guarantees that runtime-generated schedule prefixes preserve the existence of a feasible continuation without requiring complete finish-time dominance with respect to a feasible reference schedule.   Experimental results on heterogeneous DNN accelerator platforms show that the proposed framework preserves HRT schedulability while improving QoS-aware deadline satisfaction, client-level service quality, and accelerator utilization compared to state-of-the-art scheduling approaches.

papers.title_en: Motion Retargeting with Spatiotemporal Preferences for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.authors: Xiongbo Shi, Shihang Du, Zongyou Yu, Ao Zhou, Xudong Zhang, Ziyu Lin, Haodong Zhang, Junqiao Zhao, Guang Chen
papers.evidence: 面向人形机器人移动操作控制的人体运动重定向
papers.tldr: 人形机器人运动重定向需在物体交互关键阶段保持身体—物体关系，但逐帧均匀优化预算忽略局部精度需求，效率受限。为此提出STR，用视觉语言模型选取关键运动信号与身体部位并识别关键帧，为关键帧和关键部位分配更多求解迭代与交互权重，并以MCA细化接触锚定。基于所得参考，STRL结合自适应关键阶段采样与接触奖励用于下游控制。Unitree G1仿真和R1真机实验表明，STR以更低计算成本提升几何接触覆盖与连续性，并改善多类物体交互任务完成度。
papers.abstract_en: Human motion retargeting bridges the embodiment gap between humans and humanoid robots by converting human demonstrations into reference trajectories for whole-body control and loco-manipulation. For object-interaction tasks, successful execution depends on accurately preserving body--object relations at critical stages. However, uniform per-frame iteration budgets do not account for these localized accuracy requirements, limiting the computational efficiency of retargeting. To address this limitation, we present Spatiotemporal Retargeting (STR), which uses keyframes and key body parts to allocate optimization effort. Specifically, a vision-language model selects relevant motion signals and body parts, and keyframes are identified from changes in the selected signals. Based on these selections, STR assigns additional solver iterations to keyframes and higher interaction weights to the selected parts. To further improve contact fidelity, we introduce Mechanics-Aware Contact Anchoring (MCA) to refine object-surface contact positions using an approximate object-wrench model while retaining the selected surface directions. Building on the resulting references, we develop Spatiotemporal Reinforcement Learning (STRL), which combines adaptive key-stage sampling with a contact reward based on target proximity and object contact forces for downstream control. Simulation experiments on a Unitree G1 and real-world experiments on a Unitree R1 demonstrate that STR improves geometric contact coverage and continuity at lower computational cost, while the resulting references improve downstream task completion across diverse object-interaction motions.

papers.title_en: DiffDreamer: Coupling World Models with Differentiable Simulation for Agile Quadrotor Control
papers.authors: Fanxing Li, Yuxiang Huang, Shengyang Wang, Fangyu Sun, Shuyu Wu, Tianbao Zhang, Dexin Zuo, Yan Yufei, Danping Zou, Wenxian Yu
papers.evidence: 世界模型与可微仿真耦合以优化控制策略
papers.tldr: 四旋翼动态门竞速等任务需在外部运动下保持高频精确控制，但世界模型常把环境演化与机器人自身动力学耦合，模型偏差影响策略优化。DiffDreamer将学习到的世界模型与可微分仿真紧耦合：前者传播含外部动力学的隐状态，后者传播机器人显式物理状态，并分解actor目标为critic驱动与仿真驱动两路。实验表明其在激进跟踪和动态门竞速中训练收敛与最终性能优于无模型、基于模型、可微分RL及经典规划控制基线，并有真实飞行验证。
papers.abstract_en: Tasks such as quadrotor dynamic-gate racing require agents to anticipate external motion while maintaining precise high-frequency control. World-model-based reinforcement learning provides a natural solution by learning latent dynamics for future imagination, yet it often entangles environmental evolution and the robot's own dynamics in a single learned rollout, where model bias can affect policy optimization efficiency. We propose DiffDreamer, a differentiable reinforcement learning framework that tightly couples a learned world model with differentiable simulation for actor optimization. In one optimization step, the learned world model propagates latent states that capture external dynamics and history-dependent features, while the differentiable simulator propagates the robot's explicit physical state. We further decompose the actor objective into a critic-driven pathway for non-differentiable task rewards and a simulator-driven pathway for differentiable motion rewards. Experiments on aggressive tracking and dynamic-gate racing show that DiffDreamer improves training convergence over the model-free, model-based, and differentiable-RL baselines, and final performance over these baselines and classical planning and control methods. Additional experiments assess reward decomposition and the odometry-conditioned relative-state representation through ablations. We also provide proof-of-concept real-world flight experiments for validation.

papers.title_en: Beyond Finite-Sum Optimization: A Primal-Dual Method for Decentralized Finite-Max Optimization
papers.authors: Zhouxing Luo, Lei Wang, Xin Liu
papers.evidence: 去中心化凸优化的原始-对偶方法
papers.tldr: 去中心化系统常由最差代理而非平均性能评判，网络上的有限最大值优化因此重要。作者通过二次正则化把问题转化为含标量对偶变量和局部可算截断权重的光滑有限和形式，并提出交替原始-对偶梯度跟踪方法APDGT。理论分析证明网络平均序列在O(ε^{-3})次迭代内包含近似活跃梯度意义下的ε-稳定点，且聚点满足Clarke稳定性。该工作为去中心化最差性能优化提供了无需全局投影的原对偶框架。
papers.abstract_en: Many decentralized systems are judged by their worst-performing agents rather than their average performance. We study finite-max optimization over a connected undirected network, where each agent knows only its own smooth, possibly nonconvex objective. Quadratic regularization yields a smooth finite-sum representation with a scalar dual variable and locally computable clipped weights. We develop an alternating primal-dual gradient tracking (APDGT) method, using neighbor communication without any global or centralized projections. Under smoothness and level-boundedness assumptions, a localized Lyapunov analysis with vanishing regularization establishes bounded primal iterates and Clarke stationarity of every accumulation point of their network average. The averaged sequence contains an $\varepsilon$-stationary point, measured by near-active gradients, within $O (\varepsilon^{-3})$ iterations. Synthetic tests and decentralized logistic regression on Fashion-MNIST illustrate convergence behavior and potential improvements in worst-agent performance.

papers.title_en: Vulnerability Analysis for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement
papers.authors: Taozheng Zhu, Shixiong Jiang, Fanxin Kong
papers.evidence: 多智能体强化学习中的安全约束与安全代价界分析
papers.tldr: 安全多智能体强化学习能在训练中满足安全约束，但推理阶段对观测攻击的脆弱性仍缺乏系统分析。本文提出MinMax Attack，联合为被攻陷智能体选择对抗目标动作，并显式建模良性智能体的协同抵抗。作者进一步给出诱导安全代价上界，揭示其与攻陷智能体预算和扰动预算的关系。多类安全关键基准与主流SMARL算法实验显示，该方法显著抬高安全代价且保持任务奖励，兼具有效性与隐蔽性。
papers.abstract_en: Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (SMARL) aims to learn cooperative control policies under prescribed safety constraints. Al- though existing SMARL methods focus on enforcing safety during policy optimization, their vulnerability remains largely unexplored. This paper investigates inference-time observation attacks against SMARL, where an adversary perturbs the observations of a subset of agents, thereby altering the actions produced by their policies. We propose MinMax Attack, an attack framework that jointly selects adversarial target actions for compromised agents while accounting for the Cooperative Resistance of benign agents. We further derive a bound on the induced safety cost and characterize its relation- ship with the Compromised-Agent Budget and the Perturbation Budget. Experiments across multiple safety-critical multi-agent benchmarks and representative state-of-the-art SMARL algorithms show that MinMax Attack induces substantially higher safety costs than existing attack baselines while preserving task reward, thereby reducing its detectability and achieving both attack effectiveness and stealthiness.

papers.title_en: Worst-Case Bayesian CVaR Regret Bounds for Episodic Markov Decision Processes
papers.authors: Raghav Bongole, Amirreza Zamani, Tobias J. Oechtering, Mikael Skoglund
papers.evidence: 不确定性下MDP的贝叶斯CVaR遗憾界
papers.tldr: 该文研究时间齐次有限时域分幕马尔可夫决策过程，关注累积伪遗憾的贝叶斯CVaR在最坏先验下的风险敏感界。作者利用UCBVI-BF的高概率保证推导先验预测上界，并借助三状态MDP与反向KL不等式构造匹配下界。结果表明，状态数固定时上下界对时域、动作数和回合数具有相同多项式依赖，仅在风险水平上相差对数因子。该工作为分幕MDP的贝叶斯风险敏感强化学习提供了近乎紧致的理论刻画。
papers.abstract_en: We study the worst-case, over priors, Bayesian conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) of cumulative pseudo-regret in time-homogeneous finite-horizon episodic Markov decision processes. A high-probability guarantee for UCBVI-BF yields a prior-predictive upper bound. A lower bound follows by a three-state MDP and applying a reverse-KL inequality. For a constant number of states, the bounds have the same polynomial dependence on horizon, actions, and episodes, with a logarithmic gap in the risk level.

papers.title_en: Interaction-Gated Time-Frequency Learning for Parameter-Efficient PPG-Based Heart Rate Estimation
papers.authors: Anh Khoi Pham, Phat Lam, Thien Truong Nguyen Ly, Lam Pham
papers.evidence: 采用空洞深度可分离卷积的高效双分支网络结构
papers.tldr: PPG心率估计易受波形畸变和干扰影响，时域形态与频域周期性互补但难以在轻量模型中有效融合。为此，论文提出TF-IG，采用时域与频域双分支，并通过交互门控融合显式建模特征一致性与差异。在BIDMC数据集上，其MAE为1.227 BPM、RMSE为2.060 BPM，相关系数0.9934，仅84.6K参数。结果表明跨域交互可在低参数量下取得良好精度-复杂度权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Photoplethysmography (PPG) enables low-cost and non-invasive heart rate (HR) monitoring but remains sensitive to waveform distortion, physiological variability, and measurement interference. Temporal waveform characteristics and frequency-domain periodicity provide complementary information for HR estimation; however, effectively exploring and integrating these representations within a compact model remains challenging. This paper proposes TF-IG, a parameter-efficient interaction-gated time-frequency learning framework for PPG-based HR estimation. TF-IG employs a dual-branch architecture in which a temporal branch captures pulse morphology via dilated depthwise-separable convolutions, while a frequency branch extracts cardiac periodicity information from bounded log-spectrogram representations. To combine the two domains, we introduce an interaction-gated fusion module that explicitly models feature agreement and discrepancy, while also learning feature-wise weights to balance temporal and spectral information. A parameter-shared regression head further maps the temporal, spectral, and fused representations into the final HR prediction space. Experiments on the benchmark BIDMC PPG and Respiration Dataset using a subject-exclusive training, validation, and test protocol show that TF-IG achieves a mean absolute error (MAE) of 1.227 BPM, a root mean square error (RMSE) of 2.060 BPM, a Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.9934, and 92.28 percent of estimates within 3 BPM, while remaining parameter-efficient with only 84.6K parameters. Ablation results further demonstrate the complementary contributions of the temporal and frequency branches, interaction-gated fusion, and shared regression head. These results indicate that explicitly modeling cross-domain interactions provides an effective accuracy-complexity trade-off for lightweight PPG-based HR estimation.

papers.title_en: A Transformer-based Approach for Real-time Multi-agent Path Planning with Varying Initial/Final Conditions
papers.authors: Qian Zhang, Shanqing Liu, Jerome Darbon, George Karniadakis
papers.evidence: 用Transformer网络求解多智能体规划的高维约束最优控制
papers.tldr: 多智能体实时路径规划受初始/终止条件与碰撞约束制约，传统HJB/PMP求解随智能体数量增长而难以扩展。OCFormer用Transformer参数化从解耦潜空间到耦合物理空间的坐标变换逆映射，并以PMP哈密顿ODE残差和边界匹配构造无数据物理损失训练。模型具备置换等变性，单次前向约220ms即可为未见边界条件生成近最优轨迹，并可用L-BFGS秒级迁移适应分布外扰动。二维/三维最多128智能体实验验证了其可扩展性与效率。
papers.abstract_en: We address the problem of real-time multi-agent path planning under prescribed initial and final configurations, formulated as a high-dimensional optimal control problem subject to inter-agent collision avoidance and obstacle constraints. Classical solvers based on the Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equation or Pontryagin's maximum principle (PMP) become computationally intractable as the number of agents grows, due to the curse of dimensionality and the non-convexity introduced by interaction constraints. We propose OCFormer, a transformer-based neural network that parameterizes the inverse of a coordinate transformation mapping a simple, analytically tractable latent space, in which agents evolve independently under a decoupled Hamiltonian, to the physical space of the coupled, interacting system. The model is trained by minimizing a physics-informed loss comprising the Hamiltonian ODE residual from the PMP and a boundary matching term, without requiring pre-computed trajectory data. The self-attention mechanism endows OCFormer with permutation equivariance over agents, a structural symmetry that prior symplectic network approaches do not natively enforce. When trained on a distribution of boundary conditions, the amortized OCFormer produces near-optimal trajectories for unseen initial and final configurations in a single forward pass ($\sim$220ms), enabling real-time inference without retraining. We further introduce a lightweight transfer learning framework that adapts a pretrained OCFormer to out-of-distribution perturbations in seconds via L-BFGS fine-tuning. Numerical experiments on two- and three-dimensional multi-agent navigation with up to 128 agents demonstrate the scalability and efficiency of the proposed approach.

papers.title_en: Continuous-Time Motion Planning and Steering with Global Convergence
papers.authors: Mohsen Amiri, Sima Didari, Davoud Ataee Tarzanagh, Hankyu Moon, Yeongdae Kwon
papers.evidence: 具有可证明全局收敛性的连续时间约束运动规划
papers.tldr: 连续时间运动规划要求约束在运动全程成立，但兼顾平滑代价时缺乏可证明全局收敛的算法。作者将规划与策略引导统一为连续时间非凸程序，提出基于分段多项式曲线的梯度投影方法 GlobMP，交替降代价与恢复可行性。理论上随分段数增加代价逼近全局最优且约束满足容差。实验在多达200机器人、Robotarium、迷宫和双臂人形触觉策略引导上优于强基线。
papers.abstract_en: Motion planning is central to robotics, and it is increasingly used to correct the motions proposed by learned planners and policies. In both uses, constraints must hold at every instant of the motion, not only at sampled times. To our knowledge, no algorithm provably converges to a globally optimal motion once a smoothness cost is combined with such constraints. We cast planning and steering as a single continuous-time program: robots avoid one another and static or moving obstacles, and a learned proposal is steered by keeping the motion close to it. The program is elementary to state, yet nonconvex. We propose GlobMP (Global Motion Planning), a gradient projection method over piecewise-polynomial curves, on which each constraint is one polynomial per piece that must stay nonnegative over the whole motion; it alternates cost reduction with feasibility restoration. Under mild assumptions, we show that, from a fine grid start, its cost approaches the global optimum as the number of polynomial pieces grows, with every constraint met to any chosen tolerance, or exactly on stable instances. We demonstrate its superior performance over strong baselines in real and synthetic experiments, including teams of up to $200$ robots, multi-robot planning on the Robotarium testbed and an extended benchmark, maze navigation, and steering tactile-reactive policies on a bimanual humanoid.

papers.title_en: Width and Depth Limits Commute During Training
papers.authors: Ruijia Zhang, Soufiane Hayou
papers.evidence: 残差网络训练中无限宽与无限深极限
papers.tldr: 无限宽与无限深残差网络的极限能否在训练中交换，是理解尺度极限的关键问题。作者在线性残差网络中沿用 Depth-μP 的 1/√depth 分支缩放与 μP 宽度参数化，分析带梯度裁剪的固定步数梯度下降。证明输出沿任意联合宽度—深度增长路径在 L^2 中收敛，因此两个无限极限在整个有限训练时域内可交换。无裁剪时一般无 L^2 收敛，仅能证明依概率收敛。
papers.abstract_en: Recent work established that the infinite-width and infinite-depth limits of residual networks commute at initialization when residual branches are scaled by $1/\sqrt{depth}$. In particular, the network output converges to the same limit whether width and depth tend to infinity sequentially or jointly. We extend this commutativity result to training in linear residual networks. Under the same $1/\sqrt{depth}$ residual-branch scaling (Depth-$μ$P) and the $μ$P width parameterization, we prove that, for any fixed number of gradient-descent steps with gradient clipping, the network output converges in $L^2$ along every joint width--depth growth path as both width and depth tend to infinity. Consequently, the infinite-width and infinite-depth limits commute throughout any finite training horizon. Without gradient clipping, the corresponding $L^2$ convergence does not hold in general, but we establish the weaker convergence in probability.

papers.title_en: Ground-Truth-First Benchmarking of Reinforcement Learning via Converse Optimality: From Smooth, Fully Observed Systems to Non-Smooth or Partially Observed Tasks
papers.authors: Grégoire Ouerdane, Sinan Ibrahim, Stefan Streif, Pavel Osinenko
papers.evidence: 基于逆最优性将最优值函数与强化学习联系的真值优先基准
papers.tldr: 强化学习基准通常只能相对排名，最优差距不可观测且受奖励、随机性、超参和仿真细节影响。本文提出基于逆最优性的“真值优先”框架，为每个任务构造经认证的最优值函数与策略，仅用于评估而向学习器隐藏。框架统一连续时间敏感性基准与离散时间 oracle 参照比较，并扩展到非光滑、非仿射和部分可观测任务。在平面臂、非完整车辆和四旋翼类任务上复现了优化器敏感性与最优差距等定量结果。
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarking in reinforcement learning is usually relative: algorithms are ranked by returns on environments with unknown optima. Distance to optimality remains unobservable, while conclusions may depend on reward design, stochasticity, hyperparameters, environment selection, and simulator details. We develop a ground-truth-first framework based on converse optimality, constructing each task with a certified optimal value function and policy withheld from learners and used only for evaluation. The framework unifies two modes: sensitivity benchmarking samples certified environments from continuous-time generators to assess robustness to task variation, while oracle-referenced comparison uses native discrete-time generators to evaluate policies via optimality gap, regret, and policy error. Continuous-time models support physically interpretable sensitivity studies but introduce dependence on the simulator step ($Δt$) and numerical scheme. Native discrete-time models align the environment, oracle, and learner on the same transition law, eliminating external integration choices as a confounder. We reproduce quantitative results covering optimizer sensitivity and oracle-referenced comparisons on serial planar arms, dynamically extended nonholonomic vehicles, and quadrotor-inspired tasks. The methodology extends beyond smooth affine Gaussian systems: virtual-input pullback handles non-affine raw-action interfaces and finite-covariance non-Gaussian disturbances. A non-smooth converse optimality formulation enables certified benchmarks with kinked value functions and switching surfaces. For partially observed evaluation, an information-state formulation reduces benchmarking to converse optimality on a sufficient statistic and provides an information-penalty reference. Code, fixtures, and diagnostics are available on the public project page.
